description: V0.8B (unofficial, in progress): repo-reorganization and staged-implementation tasks for the PHP payment-portal (paygate-php-portal) and Rust+TypeScript desktop (vaultdesk-tauri) repos. 4 reorg tasks scored against a deterministic structure_contract (0.70 hidden_behavior + 0.25 structure_contract + 0.05 artifact_integrity), and 8 staged manifests in 4 groups. The reorg tasks run through normal run-suite. The staged manifests are listed here for doctor-suite validation and single-stage runs, but a staged GROUP must be run through `tokenbench run-staged` so Stage 2 executes on Stage 1's candidate output and extension-friction telemetry is produced (staged_score.json). Not an official leaderboard suite until Opus-baselined.
